rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: UAST’s Provenance Chain Verification uses deterministic cryptographic attestations, Merkle-tree context hashes, and signed append-only tool logs to validate the integrity and chain of custody of agent-generated code artifacts; its governance layer also enforces policy constraints and monitors policy drift.
